2123156770021331151.en_summary: Jensen gonna be back. Quoted: Nvidia $NVDA is moving up pay raises and stock grants to hold on to employees after Jensen Huang’s exit, per WIRED.
2123156770021331151.zh_summary: Jensen 將會回來。引用：Nvidia $NVDA 正在提前加薪和股票授予，以在 Jensen Huang 離任後留住員工，據 WIRED。

2123156466013970553.en_summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) interim CEO Colette Kress promised employees accelerated pay raises and additional equity awards in December, months ahead of the usual spring schedule, as leadership seeks to restore morale following Jensen Huang’s resignation.
2123156466013970553.zh_summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 承諾員工在十二月提前加薪和額外股權獎勵，比通常的春季時間表提前數月，領導層尋求在 Jensen Huang 辭職後恢復士氣。

2123155707990319562.en_summary: Anthropic $ANT is considering pricing its IPO at up to $85 per share, above its original $70-$78 range, per BBG. At $85, the 825M shares on offer would raise $70.1B, or $80.6B with the full overallotment option. That would imply a fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.53T.
2123155707990319562.zh_summary: Anthropic $ANT 正考慮將其 IPO 定價最高每股 85 美元，高於其原始 70-78 美元範圍，據 BBG。按 85 美元，發行的 8.25 億股將籌集 701 億美元，或在全額超額配售選項下為 806 億美元。這將意味著完全稀釋估值約 1.53 萬億美元。

ticker_notes.ANT: 考慮IPO價最高85美元，隱含估值約1.53萬億美元

2123155688398668126.en_summary: Anthropic's IPO is tomorrow. I am not planning to buy shares of $ANT. I don't think it's a company that I want to invest in both because it's fundamentally very expensive and the culture seems quite broken and unethical.
2123155688398668126.zh_summary: Anthropic 的 IPO 在明天。我不計劃購買 $ANT 的股份。我不認為這是一家我想投資的公司，因為它基本上非常昂貴，而且文化似乎相當破碎和不道德。

ticker_notes.ANT: 基本面非常昂貴，文化破碎不道德，不計劃買入
